mentions.name: Loopspin
mentions.description: A table tennis VR game featuring human-like AI opponents trained on roughly 25 hours of the builder's own gameplay, running in real time on a Quest 3 headset.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a table tennis VR game with human-like AI. It's trained on roughly 25 hours of me playing against myself and runs in real time on a Quest 3: https://loopspin.gg
